title: Exact constants comparison commutes with single complexes
statement: Let F:C→D,H:D→E,K:C→E be exact additive functors between abelian categories with derived categories, and e:F⋙H≅K. The descended isomorphism (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F H) inverse followed by mapDerivedCategoryNatIso e, evaluated on single X and followed by the K single comparison, equals H_D of the F single comparison, then the H single comparison, then single(e_X).

source.place: Tag 07A6, lemma-adjoint, and compatibility of the Hom bijections with composition and localization.

proof.text: Expand the localization factorization of exact composition and naturality of the factors. The remaining equality of complex single comparisons is checked in degree zero. The same localization argument for a natural isomorphism gives its single comparison. Compose the two equalities and cancel the inverse composition isomorphism.

theorem derived_single_constants_comparison
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [Abelian E]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasDerivedCategory E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (H : D ⥤ E) (K : C ⥤ E)
    [F.Additive] [H.Additive] [K.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits K] [PreservesFiniteColimits K]
    (e : F ⋙ H ≅ K) (X : C) :
    ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F H).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso e).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj X) ≫
      (K.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app X =
    H.mapDerivedCategory.map ((F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app X) ≫
      (H.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app (F.obj X) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor E 0).map (e.hom.app X)
